rows.label: 在写
rows.text: 收藏的推文，怎样才算真正读懂了

projects.name: Say Right
projects.why: 我自己要练英语：从一句中文想法出发，练出地道的英文表达。
projects.introduction: 先用中文写下想说的话，再自己试着用英文说，最后对照更自然的说法。错过的表达会按间隔重复排进复习，练的是自己真正想说的句子，而不是课本上的。

projects.name: Home Task
projects.why: 家里人总忘事，说一句话就能建好带时间的任务。
projects.introduction: 家里人不愿意填表单，所以入口只有一个输入框。一句「周六上午带猫打疫苗」会被拆成日期、时段和提醒；拆不准的交给模型，再让人确认一次。

projects.name: Vocab Master
projects.why: 读英文时只学自己不认识的那几个词。
projects.introduction: 贴进一段英文，标出自己不认识的词，只把这些词放进复习。核心的排程后来并进了 Say Right，这个项目就停在这里了。

en.introduction: · Seven years as a backend and full-stack engineer. Java, Node.js, Python, React; payments, finance, distributed systems. I can build a product from the ground up, on my own.

rows.label: Writing
rows.text: What it takes to actually understand a saved tweet

projects.name: Say Right
projects.why: I needed to practise English: start from a thought in Chinese, end up with natural English.
projects.introduction: Write what you want to say in Chinese, try saying it in English yourself, then compare with a more natural version. The phrases you missed come back on a spaced-repetition schedule, so you practise sentences you actually want to say, not textbook ones.

projects.name: Home Task
projects.why: My family kept forgetting things. Say one sentence, get a task with a time attached.
projects.introduction: My family won't fill in forms, so there is only one input box. “Take the cat for her jab on Saturday morning” becomes a date, a time slot and a reminder; whatever the rules can't parse goes to a model, and a person confirms it once.

projects.name: Vocab Master
projects.why: Read in English and learn only the words you don't know yet.
projects.introduction: Paste in some English, mark the words you don't know, and only those go into review. The scheduling core later moved into Say Right, so this one stops here.

books.title: A Philosophy of Software Design

books.note: Second time through. This time I'm watching how “deep modules” show up in my own code.
